Cause of chemical bonding :
1. To achieve Noble gas configuration or octet rule i.e an atom gains or loose e to become stable and to obtain 8 e in it's valence shell.
2 . To lower potential energy of the system of atoms .
 The nucleus of one atom attracts  outermost e of other atom.
